notes: Style: Dynamic Word Reels. See styles/DYNAMIC-WORD-REELS.md before editing.
No running captions. One keyword per phrase: dw-word (light lead + blue italic serif keyword BEHIND the person).
Open with dw-blink at 0s. Every phrase = one graphic scene, fully cleared before the next.
Graphics land 0.1-0.3 s BEFORE their keyword; chips land ON the spoken word; counters finish just AFTER the number word.
Entrances: 5-6 frame blur-in. Exits: 6 frame blur + horizontal smear. Hide hard cuts with dw-blur-whip in breath pauses.
Numbers: styles/tools/dw_counter.py (glossy ice-blue, no outline). Measurements: dw-measure. Charts: dw-area-chart.
Sound: soft whoosh per keyword, typing under search, pop per chip, sparkle on counter landing, low music bed under VO.
Light/bright backgrounds: pass "lead_color":"#2E353C" to dw-word so the thin lead line stays readable.

Sound design: set auto_sfx false and place every sound as {"type":"sfx"} events (auto_sfx false also mutes effects' built-in sounds). Keep whooshes ~0.16, typing ~0.2, one sparkle on the price, a click on the CTA, music bed ~0.09 ducked.
Keep numbers and labels off the face: put counters on the torso (y ~1300 for a mid shot).
